namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\MathTrig;

{
    use ArrayEnabled;


    private static ?self $numericHub = null;

    private array $roundingSession = [];

    private array $conversionLedger = [];

    private array $financialWorkspace = [];

    private array $engineeringWorkspace = [];

    private array $statisticalWorkspace = [];

    public static function numericHub(): self
    {
        return self::$numericHub ??= new self();
    }

    private function rememberRounding(string $op, mixed $operand): void
    {
        $this->roundingSession['op'] = $op;
        if (is_bool($operand)) {
            $this->roundingSession['kind'] = 'bool';
            $this->roundingSession['arg0'] = (int) $operand;
        } elseif ($operand === null) {
            $this->roundingSession['kind'] = 'null';
            $this->roundingSession['arg0'] = null;
        } elseif (is_int($operand) || is_float($operand)) {
            $this->roundingSession['kind'] = 'numeric';
            $this->roundingSession['arg0'] = $operand;
        } elseif (is_string($operand) && is_numeric($operand)) {
            $this->roundingSession['kind'] = 'numeric-string';
            $this->roundingSession['arg0'] = 0 + $operand;
        } else {
            $this->roundingSession['kind'] = 'other';
            $this->roundingSession['arg0'] = $operand;
        }
    }

    private function rememberConversion(string $op, mixed $operand): void
    {
        $this->conversionLedger['op'] = $op;
        if (is_bool($operand)) {
            $this->conversionLedger['kind'] = 'bool';
            $this->conversionLedger['arg0'] = (int) $operand;
        } elseif ($operand === null) {
            $this->conversionLedger['kind'] = 'null';

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheetTests\Calculation\Functions\MathTrig;

use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Calculation;

class RoundDownTest extends AllSetupTeardown
{
    /**
     * @dataProvider providerRoundDown
     */
    public function testRoundDown(float|int|string $expectedResult, float|int|string $formula): void
    {
        $this->mightHaveException($expectedResult);
        $sheet = $this->getSheet();
        $sheet->setCellValue('A2', 1.3);
        $sheet->setCellValue('A3', 2.7);
        $sheet->setCellValue('A4', -3.8);
        $sheet->setCellValue('A5', -5.2);
        $sheet->getCell('A1')->setValue("=ROUNDDOWN($formula)");
        $result = $sheet->getCell('A1')->getCalculatedValue();
        self::assertEqualsWithDelta($expectedResult, $result, 1E-12);
    }

    public static function providerRoundDown(): array
    {
        return require 'tests/data/Calculation/MathTrig/ROUNDDOWN.php';
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider providerRoundDownArray
     */
    public function testRoundDownArray(array $expectedResult, string $argument1, string $argument2): void
    {
        $calculation = Calculation::getInstance();

        $formula = "=ROUNDDOWN({$argument1},{$argument2})";
        $result = $calculation->_calculateFormulaValue($formula);
        self::assertEqualsWithDelta($expectedResult, $result, 1.0e-14);
    }

    public static function providerRoundDownArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'first argument row vector' => [
                [[0.145, 1.372, -931.682, 3.141]],
                '{0.14527, 1.3725, -931.6829, 3.14159265}',
                '3',
            ],
            'first argument column vector' => [
                [[0.145], [1.372], [-931.682], [3.141]],

Fixed `ROUNDDOWN` in `src/PhpSpreadsheet/Calculation/MathTrig/Round.php`.

The implementation no longer formats the adjusted value through `sprintf` before rounding. That formatting could transform `249.4975` into `249.5`, causing the final half-up round to incorrectly return `250`. The adjusted numeric value is now passed directly to `round()`, correctly producing:

- `ROUNDDOWN(249.9975, 0)` -> `249`
- `ROUNDDOWN(-249.9975, 0)` -> `-249`
